about: The Jacob D. Fuchsberg Law Firm is a New York personal injury practice based in a single Manhattan office. The firm describes its work as representing victims of medical malpractice and of negligence in police custody.
It states that it works on a contingency basis, with no fees unless the case is won, and publishes a free consultation, a 24-hour intake line and material in English and Spanish.
